div.p: (Hereinafter referred to as the “Company”) We are pleased to appoint you on the terms and conditions as detailed under. The terms of this Appointment Letter (hereinafter referred to as the “Agreement”) supersede all other communications made to you prior to the execution of this Agreement.

li.p: Role & Responsibilities:
Your role and associated responsibilities shall be as detailed under Annexure I of this Agreement. The Company shall have the right to reassign your reporting to any other position as it deems fit.

During your employment with the Company, you will perform your duties faithfully and to the best of your ability and you will devote your full business efforts and time to the Company. You will discharge all your obligations and diligently undertake all activities as required by the Company. You shall in the discharge of your employment obligations behave in an honest and ethical manner.

During your employment with the Company, you will not engage in any other activities that conflict with your obligations to the Company or the full discharge of your duties with the Company, without the prior approval of the Company. For the avoidance of doubt, it is not permitted for you to seek alternative employment either whole time or part time, or associate with any firm, person or organization as an advisor, director or partner, whether for remuneration or not while you are an employee of the Company, unless otherwise agreed in writing between you and the Company.
Employment Term

Subject to the termination rights specified in this Agreement, your employment shall commence on the date of joining mention above and subject to your successful confirmation on completion of probation as specified in Section 2(b) shall continue till the event of your retirement as detailed herein. You will retire from the employment of the Company on the last day in the month in which you attain your sixtieth (60) birth anniversary.
Performance Review

An appraisal of your performance may be conducted by the Company on such periodicity as the Company deems appropriate. Such appraisal may be used by the Company in determination of any target bonuses, increments, incentives or other reward mechanism. Any target bonuses, increments or other incentives may be provided at the sole discretion of the Company.

You hereby acknowledge that the salary paid under this Agreement is sufficient consideration and the Company may at its discretion, provide additional benefits from time to time which it may withdraw at its sole discretion upon notice.
Remuneration
Your annual compensation and break-up of your compensation shall be as detailed under Annexure II of this Agreement.

In addition to the compensation as laid down in Annexure II to this Agreement, you may be entitled to such other benefits as may be granted by the Company, in its sole discretion to employees of similar rank and position from time to time. You may also be eligible for incentives based on the incentive scheme of the Company as adopted by it and in accordance with any modifications to it made from time to time.
Your monthly compensation shall be paid by means of wire transfer.
All payments made pursuant to this Agreement will be subject to withholding of applicable taxes.
Place of Work

Your place of work will be
However, you may be required to work in other locations in India or overseas

You hereby consent to the transfer in your location, to provide services to the Company’s customers, subsidiaries or affiliates, based on business needs. In such an event, the Company will do its best to accommodate, solely at its discretion, any requests or preferences that you may have with respect to location or other matters in accordance with Company policy. In the event of your transfer to another location, remuneration and other benefits shall be determined in accordance with the Company's existing policies in that regard, at its discretion.
Employee Benefits and Leave policies

During the term of your employment with the Company, you may be entitled to participate in the employee benefit plans being put in place and hereafter will be maintained by the Company if you meet the eligibility criteria as determined by the Company, in its sole discretion. You understand that the Company reserves the right to cancel or change the benefit plans and programs it offers to its employees at any time, for any or no reason, and with or without notice.

During the term of your employment with the Company, you will be entitled to leave under the leave policies being put in place and hereafter will be maintained by the Company of general applicability to similarly situated employees of the Company. You understand that the Company reserves the right to cancel or change the leave it offers to its employees at any time, for any or no reason, with or without notice.
Confidentiality

During the course of your employment with the Company, it is likely that you will come into possession of or become familiar (whether disclosed orally, visually, in writing or howsoever) with the confidential or proprietary technical, financial, marketing, distribution, training or other technical or business information or trade secrets of the Company, including without limitation, policies, business plans, go to market strategies, strategies in general, employee details, contractor information, client information and data, cost data, pricing information and other commercial terms, terms and conditions of contracts and transactions between the clients/vendors and the Company, business plans concepts, techniques, training, algorithms, processes, methods, methodologies, systems, designs, computer programs, formulae, development or experimental work, inventions, processes, protocols and work in progress (the “Confidential Information”). You understand that you have access to such information only by virtue of your employment with the Company and has a continuing obligation to protect all such information from disclosure during and post the termination of your employment with the Company.

You hereby agree and undertake that you shall maintain strict confidentiality of the Confidential Information and will not disclose or use any Confidential Information except for the benefit of the Company and to the extent necessary to perform your obligations to the Company, in the course of your employment. You undertake that you shall not disclose the Confidential Information to any person at any time during or after your employment with the Company without the prior written approval of the Company. You further agree that you will not claim or represent that you have any interest by way of ownership, assignment or otherwise in the same. You further undertake not to make copies of such Confidential Information except as authorized by the Company.

You shall, upon request or upon the termination of your employment relationship with the Company howsoever occurring, promptly return to the Company all materials, IT assets (including but not limited to laptops, computers, hard drives), writings, equipment, models, materials, books, mechanisms, and the like obtained from or through the Company, including, but not limited to, all Confidential Information, all of which you acknowledge is the sole and exclusive property of the Company.

During employment with the Company, you shall not use improperly or disclose any confidential or proprietary information or trade secrets of your former employers, principals, partners, co-ventures, clients, customers or suppliers of the vendors or customers of such persons or entities or their vendor or customers and you shall not bring onto the premises of the Company or introduce in the Company systems, any unpublished document or any property belonging to any such persons or entities or their vendors or customers unless such persons or entities have given their consent. You undertake that you shall not violate any non- disclosure or proprietary rights agreement you may have signed with any such person or entity.
Intellectual Property Rights

You acknowledge and agree that all inventions, improvements, discoveries, methods, processes, developments, software and works of authorship, whether or not patentable or copyrightable, which are created, made, conceived or reduced to practice by you or under your direction or jointly with others during the employment whether or not during normal working hours or on the premises of the Company or any of its affiliates (all of which are collectively referred to herein as “Inventions”) shall, upon creation, vest with the Company hence shall be the proprietary property of the Company. To the extent that the rights in the Inventions do not vest in the Company, by contract or operation of law, you hereby absolutely and unconditionally assign to the Company (or any person or entity designated by the Company) all your right (including any and all intellectual property rights), title and interest in and to all Inventions, as and when such Inventions are created. Such assignment shall, to the extent permissible by applicable law, be automatic, without requiring any further acts by you or by the Company. You further agree to cooperate fully with the Company to enable the Company to procure, maintain and enforce the intellectual property rights in such Inventions and other works.
Consent to use Personal Information

You hereby consent to the collection of your personal information including but not limited to your sensitive personal information by the Company for the purposes of conducting background checks and verifications and for the processing of your benefits while you are employed with the Company. You also consent to the Company sharing your personal information with authorised third parties for legitimate purposes in connection with the Company’s business in compliance with applicable law.
Use of Email

It is strictly forbidden to use Ekara ’s email system for anything other than legitimate business purposes. Under no circumstances personal email address to be used to send official mail communication and vice versa. Inappropriate use of personal email address for official communication and corporate email address for personal communication can lead to disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.
Discipline
You will be governed by the Company’s rules, regulations and policies that are updated and published from time to time.
You are expected to maintain a high level of professionalism at all times, whether within the Company premises or any other associated premises including client and vendor premises.

You shall not publicly criticize, defame or misrepresent the Company, its employees, directors or other personnel and shall not, knowingly, conduct yourself in a manner which may result in the Company’s name, image, goodwill or business is tarnished.
Termination:
You may terminate this Agreement for convenience by providing sixty (60) days written notice. Provided that during your probation period, this notice period shall be thirty (30) days.
The Company may terminate this Agreement during your probation period by providing you with thirty (30) days written notice or salary in lieu of such notice.
After you have been confirmed, the Company may terminate your employment at any time by giving sixty (60) days written notice or salary in lieu of such notice.

Notwithstanding anything contained herein, the Company may in its sole discretion, immediately terminate you for a breach of this Agreement, non-performance, misconduct, failure to successfully complete any performance improvement plan or for any other disciplinary reasons. If the Company believes it is necessary as a party of any disciplinary proceedings or in order to investigate a complaint against you, the Company may suspend you for so long as it may think fit without prejudice to the Company’s right to subsequently terminate this Agreement on the same or any other ground.

Voluntary Termination: On voluntary termination, you shall receive any accrued but unpaid salary, benefits and all other payments on the next regularly scheduled payroll date or as required by applicable law. However, the Company shall have the right to deduct any outstanding amounts owed by you to the Company, as well as losses to the Company, directly arising out of your acts of omission or commission, and you, now irrevocably, authorize the Company to deduct such outstanding amounts from your full and final settlement.

Involuntary Termination :
If at any time, in the opinion of the Company, which is final in this matter, you are found guilty of dishonesty, disobedience, disorderly behaviour, negligence, indiscipline, absence from duty without prior permission, committing a breach of any of the terms, conditions and stipulations contained in the appointment letter and on your part to be observed and performed or in violation of one or more terms of the said letter, or any other conduct considered by the Company as being detrimental to its interests, your services are liable to be terminated forthwith, without any notice nor salary in lieu of notice period. Without prejudice to any other action, rights or remedies available to the Company by law, you shall be liable to make good any consequent damage or loss caused, and you shall irrevocably, authorize the Company to deduct all such damages or losses from your full and final settlement. Further, to the extent permitted by applicable law, you may forfeit any arrears or benefits, at the discretion of the Company.

On the termination of your employment, you shall immediately deliver to the Company, all materials and equipment of the Company or any other property relating to the Company or its business which are in your possession. For the purpose of clarity, you shall vacate any accommodation, if any provided by the Company, return computing equipment, mobile phones, credit cards or any other Company provided material or equipment.
During any period of notice of termination, whether such notice has been given by the Company or by you, the Company shall have the right to assign or reduce your duties.

At all times during any period of notice of termination served in accordance hereunder, you shall continue to be bound by the same obligations as were owed to the Company prior to the commencement of the notice period and the Company shall continue to pay you in accordance with the entitlements under this Agreement.
Non- Competition

You undertake to the Company that during the period of your employment with the Company and for a further period of twelve (12) months from the date you ceases to be in the employment of the Company (“Non-Compete Period”), you shall refrain, either directly or indirectly, from engaging in any similar or Competing Business as that of the Company or its affiliates, either as an individual, independent contractor, unit holder member, principal, agent, partner, director, employee, secondee, consultant, advisor in of or to any person who carries it on except on behalf of the Company. For the purposes of this Clause, “Competing Business” shall mean, directly or indirectly, engaged in the business same as the Company’s.
Training

You acknowledge that the Company shall be providing training for the betterment of your professional skills at the time of joining of the Company’s employment. You further acknowledge that the Company shall be incurring expenditure and considerable efforts for training and the Company would incur loss should you leave the services of the Company during the Expected Employment Period. “Expected Employment Period” means the period of a minimum of one (1) year after the training is completed.

You hereby undertake to remain in Company’s employment for the Expected Employment Period. Should you elect to resign from the Company during the Expected Employment Period, you agree that the Company shall be entitled to recover the actual expenditure incurred on your training, which shall in the aggregate, not exceed the equivalent of one (1) year salary.
Non-Solicit
During the course of employment and for a period of twelve (12) months following the termination of employment with the Company you shall refrain from:

either directly or indirectly solicit, render services to or for, or accept from, anyone who is a client, customer, or a supplier of the Company (whether present or future), any business of the type performed by the Company, or persuade or attempt in any manner to persuade any client, customer, or supplier of the Company to cease to do business or to reduce the amount of business which any such client, customer, or supplier has customarily done or is reasonably expected to do with the Company;

employ as an employee or retain as a consultant any person (including individual, firm, corporation or other form of entity) who is then or at any time during the One (1) year period prior to the date of the purported solicitation was, an employee of or exclusive consultant to the Company, or persuade or attempt to persuade any employee of, or exclusive consultant to, the Company, to leave the employment of the Company or to become employed as an employee or retained as a consultant by any other person.
Acknowledgement

You agree and acknowledge that the terms of Sections 12, 13 and 14 are reasonable terms required to protect the legitimate business interests of the Company. You further agree that your employment with the Company and the training imparted to you constitute sufficient consideration for your assumption of these obligations.
Non-Assignment
Your interests under this Agreement are not subject to the claims of creditors and your successors and may not be assigned, alienated or encumbered.
Successor

This Agreement shall be binding and inure to the benefit of any successor to the Company. Any such successor of the Company shall be deemed substitute for the Company under the terms of this Agreement for all purposes.
Modification

Any modification of this Agreement or additional obligation assumed by either party in connection with this Agreement shall be binding only if evidenced in writing signed by each party or an authorized representative of each party.
Severability

Each provision/paragraph of this Agreement shall be and remain separate from and independent of and severable from all and any other provisions/paragraphs herein except where otherwise indicated by the context of the Agreement. The decision or declaration that one or more of the provisions/paragraphs are null and void shall have no effect on the remaining paragraphs of this Agreement. If any provision/paragraph of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable for any reason, such provision/paragraph shall be separable from the remainder of the provisions hereof which shall continue in full force and effect as if this Agreement had been executed with the invalid provisions/paragraphs eliminated.
Applicable Law

The validity, interpretation, construction and performance of this Agreement shall be governed by the Laws of India. Any and all disputes that arise from this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Bangalore, India.
Timings/Work week:
9:00AM to 5:30PM from Monday to Saturday every week, with the exception of National & festival holidays as declared.
